subject: [PATCH 1/6] libdaxctl: add dax kmem atomic hotplug state accessors

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch adds support for atomic whole-device hotplug to the libdaxctl library by introducing an enum and getter/setter functions for accessing the /sys/bus/dax/devices/daxX.Y/state attribute. The new functionality allows users to determine the state of a dax device, such as whether it is online or offline, and set its state accordingly. This patch is part of a larger series that aims to enhance the libdaxctl library with features related to hotplug and memory management.
